notes: Per-level monster instances from the pristine UW2 LEV.ARK (LZSS blocks decoded). hp is the object's stored hit points (byte 0x08).
combat.attacks[].to_hit_base = attacks[].chance + equip/2 (critter_attack, COMBAT.C:904); damage_base = attacks[].damage + STR/5 (COMBAT.C:903). Powerful adds the ranges shown.
Creature names come from the port's items.h comments (with the item id suffix where the name repeats); the game's own strings are in STRINGS.PAK, not parsed.
hp is as stored in the file. A critter generated at run time gets avghit * (16 + rand() % 24) / 32 (CREATURE.C); hp_authored marks stored values outside that range.
goal, attitude and old_goal are raw numbers; their meaning is not named in the sources read.

placed_on_map: the monster is on a tile's object chain. Otherwise it is held (via its link) by a create-object trap, item 0x187, which copies it onto the map when it fires; spawn_probability is (63 - trap_quality) / 63 from TRIGGER.C:297. Free-list slots that still hold creature bytes are not counted as monsters.
creature records: passive, remains, armour (255 = none at that location?) and similar fields keep the port's provisional names; see uw2/src/include/critter.h.

UW2: levels are numbered 1..80, eight to a world ((level - 1) / 8); the shipped LEV.ARK holds 42 of them. A create-object trap linked to an 'adventurer' (0x7F) makes a random monster scaled by the level and the player's level (TRIGGER.C) and is not listed.
